description: Watch companies. `action`='start' (the default) starts watching one: at most one alert a day, listing what changed with its sources; `entity_id` is the one find_company returns (or a Swiss UID), and `layers` optionally narrows it to a comma-separated list of register, sanctions, regulator (blank watches all). `action`='list' lists the companies this account watches.
name: watch_company
title: Watch company
